reconciliation_note: Summing the known_usage_bursts' tokens (160770+288332+36000(est)+36000(est)+53670 = 574772) exceeds the actual reading at the third burst's TPD hit (496486 at 2026-07-30T17:02:22Z) by roughly 78K -- even without the two estimated-token probe bursts, the three EXACT bursts alone (502772) still exceed 496486 by ~6300. This is a real reconciliation gap (~1-6% of the total, depending on how much of the probe estimate is trusted), not a bug being papered over: possible causes include Groq's actual accounting differing slightly from a naive full-24h rolling sum (e.g. a coarser window boundary), retried/rate-limited attempts consuming some token budget without a logged success line, or the probe token estimates simply being off. Treat scripts/groq_tpd_estimate.py's Used(T) projections as directionally useful, not exact -- prefer a live pre-flight probe's real reading over the projection whenever one is available.
